name: dsh-session-messenger
description: Cross-session coordination for DSH: file-claim registry (claim_files / release_files, auto-registered from fs write intents), directed session messaging (send_to_session via sessionController.prompt mode: queue | steer), conflict auto-notification, multi-round structured negotiation (negotiate: offer/counter/accept/decline/escalate with a watchdog that escalates to the human and never auto-favours the writer), and an optional write hard gate.
